It is a great honour when owners return their prize possessions to us for repairs, refits or even routine maintenance. In the photo above is the still-avant garde Siran. Launched in 1992, this year marks Siran’s third refit in Makkum. During the second refit in 2015 her aft deck was lengthened.

Behind Siran is Firebird, ex-Anna delivered in 2007. Firebird will also have a stern extension during this year period.
